scope: Recipe authority for the filtered LIBERO-90 source base and the unified downstream PI05 LoRA space.

primary_sources.claim: Official PI05 LIBERO full-finetuning configuration and data transforms.
Official LIBERO camera mapping: real base/left-wrist images and a zero right-wrist padding image with a false PI0/PI0.5 image mask.
Official AdamW defaults and learning-rate schedule definitions.
Official PI05 LIBERO 30k evaluation result and inference recipe.
Pinned PyTorch PI05 port used by EMBER.
Pinned generic base checkpoint and Gemma model license.

camera_inputs.right_wrist_0_rgb: zero padding with false mask; implemented in pinned LeRobot by omitting the missing feature key

precision.pinned_lerobot_port: bfloat16 selected parameters with numerically sensitive projections and layer norms retained in float32

ember_source_base_decision.action_chunk_reason: Preserve the sealed LeRobot conversion and all downstream EMBER functional-LoRA interfaces; execution still replans after five actions.
ember_source_base_decision.optimizer_and_schedule: Use the official AdamW/EMA anchor with a proportionally shortened 333-step linear warmup followed by constant 5e-5 LR for the 1,000-step EMBER run.
ember_source_base_decision.short_run_reason: Owner-directed interface acquisition only: the source base should receive a mild LIBERO embodiment/control update, not converge or overfit LIBERO-90. Stop at step 1,000; report any apparent undertraining for later owner review rather than extending this run.
ember_source_base_decision.normalization: filtered source corpus only; frozen for every downstream arm
ember_source_base_decision.checkpointing: one atomically replaced exact-resume checkpoint plus final frozen export and retained metrics

ema.launch_gate: retain only if the eight-GPU real-data profile remains stable with at least 10GB free per device and checkpoint peak remains below the 500GB personal cap
ema.predeclared_engine_fallback: If EMA alone violates that measured resource gate, keep full SFT but disable EMA and record the deviation; do not change data, optimizer, schedule, or target tasks.

ember_source_base_decision.last_resort_fallback: Use merged LoRA only if full SFT itself is infeasible after measured microbatch, activation-checkpointing, and accumulation profiles.

unified_downstream_lora.purpose: AS-Writer, RL-Writer, Source-SFT, task-local RL, and the final joint action oracle share this adapter space.
unified_downstream_lora.target_policy: action-expert q_proj and v_proj in all 18 layers, plus action_in_proj and action_out_proj
unified_downstream_lora.project_choice_notice: There is no official validated PI05-LIBERO LoRA recipe in the pinned OpenPI PyTorch path; this compact adapter contract must pass name/count and functional-identity smoke checks before use.
